title: E2E: peer message with attachment — deliver, fetch, download
description:
End-to-end test that proves the full attachment round-trip works.

What: two kithd instances (sender + receiver) in the test harness; sender delivers a message with an attachment; receiver's download endpoint fetches the blob from sender.

Algorithm:
1. Spin up two kithd instances using existing test harness (spawn_test_listener)
2. Upload a test blob to the sender instance via POST /jmap/upload/{accountId}
3. Confirm blob_id and sha256 returned
4. Have receiver's harness call Peer/deliver with message containing the attachment metadata (blob_id, sha256, size, etc.)
5. As the owner of the receiver, call GET /jmap/download/a-self/{blob_id}/{filename}
6. Assert HTTP 200 and response body matches the original uploaded bytes
7. Assert the blob is now cached in the receiver's blob directory

Defensive checks:
- Use fixed test bytes (not random) so test is deterministic; oracle is the known bytes themselves
- Verify Content-Type matches what was delivered
- Verify Content-Disposition contains the original filename

Note: this test requires the two-instance harness pattern; check if existing e2e.rs already supports this or needs extension.
